verdict.rationale: Superpowers keeps nothing in a proprietary store. Skills are plain, selectively installable markdown folders (hands-on probe), plans and specs end up as Markdown docs, the per-plan workspace lives in the project directory with git history as the durable record, and skills are harness-agnostic across many agents, so leaving needs no export step. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of data portability or uninstall/offboarding, and any note on keeping the ephemeral `.superpowers/sdd` workspace data, which is deleted after review.
